name: The Rise of the Machines
label: Quest
description: Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania has found initials and a rank marking on the elemental shards, and the machines you brought down in the Burning Steppes…
intro: Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania has found initials and a rank marking on the elemental shards, and the machines you brought down in the Burning Steppes bore Rank IV. Theodora sends you with a shard sample to Lotwil Veriatus, a scholar of elemental sciences, in a camp to the east.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Those are the 'initials' imprinted on the elemental shards. Below the initials are a rank marking of some sort. The machinations you destroyed in the Burning Steppes were of 'Rank IV.' I assume that this is a lowly rank.
Take this shard sample to Lotwil Veriatus in the camp to the east. He is a scholar of some renown in the field of elemental sciences. He may be able to assist us in our search.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What have you got there, traveler?
